bannerCrop.title: Position banner
bannerCrop.description: Frame the cover. Drag to move, pinch or scroll to zoom.

crop.title: Position avatar
crop.description: Drag to move. Pinch or scroll to zoom.
crop.keyboard: Arrow keys move the picture. Plus and minus zoom, C centers, 0 resets.

preview.emptyBody: Describe an avatar below, or start from your own image.
preview.unchanged: The avatar already on the form

mode.label: What to do
mode.generateHint: Starts over from the description only

prompt.label: Describe the avatar
prompt.placeholder: A smiling fox in a knitted scarf, soft lighting

options.title: Could not check the avatar model

disabled.title: Avatar generation is off
disabled.body: Turn it on in image settings to generate. Uploading still works.

noModel.title: No avatar model chosen
noModel.body: Choose a model that accepts and returns images. Uploading still works.

incompatible.title: This model cannot make avatars
incompatible.body: Avatars need a model that accepts and returns images. Uploading still works.

cancellation.title: Could not cancel
cancellation.body: The request may still be running. Try cancelling again.

uncertain.title: Waiting for the result
uncertain.body: The connection dropped before the result arrived. Try again to reconnect, or cancel the request.

failure.setup: The image model is not set up correctly. Check it in image settings.
failure.invalidRequest: The request was not accepted. Change the description and try again.
failure.engine: The image engine stopped before it finished.
failure.timedOut: The image took too long to make.
failure.memory: The image model ran out of memory.
failure.storage: The image could not be saved.
failure.provider: The provider could not make the image.
failure.rejected: The result was set aside and nothing was returned.
failure.refused: The model declined to make this image. Change the description and try again.
failure.authentication: The provider rejected the credentials. Check the provider in settings.
failure.unavailable: The image model is not available right now.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong while making the image.
